blocks.text: The AI assistant built for thoughtful analysis, coding, and long-form work

Claude, built by Anthropic, has established itself as the AI assistant of choice for work that requires careful reasoning, nuanced writing, and processing large amounts of context. With a 200K+ token context window, Claude can analyze entire codebases, research papers, or legal documents in a single conversation.

For development teams, Claude Code (the agentic coding CLI) represents a step change in AI-assisted programming. It understands project context, makes changes across multiple files, runs tests, and iterates on feedback - functioning more like a junior developer than a code autocomplete tool.

Claude's approach to safety and accuracy makes it particularly suitable for professional contexts. It is more likely to acknowledge uncertainty rather than confabulate, follows instructions precisely, and maintains consistency across long conversations - qualities that matter when the output influences real business decisions.
200K+ token window for analyzing large documents and codebases
Agentic coding CLI that understands project context and makes multi-file changes
Generate documents, code, and interactive content in a side panel
Persistent workspace with uploaded files and custom instructions
Analyze images, charts, screenshots, and diagrams
Full API for building Claude into your own applications

Claude is our daily driver for complex analysis, content creation, and development work. The extended context window and reasoning quality make it the most reliable AI assistant for professional work that demands accuracy.
Our team can integrate Claude into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
